audit_items.proof_trace: After every borrow, `try_borrow_asset` always creates or increases a debt entry (non-zero amount guaranteed by the `borrow_amount != 0` assert at L375), so `has_debt` is always true and the `assert!(current_debt.ge_u64(min_borrow_amount))` check at L165 is always evaluated. After every repay, a full repay removes the debt entry (`has_debt` false → early return, remaining_debt == 0) and a partial repay checks the remaining debt against `min_borrow_amount`, aborting the transaction if dust would result. No borrow or repay path bypasses this invariant.
